description: A sheet of paper with a blue water scene and green lily pads sits on the desk, with a watercolor palette to the right, a white cup nearby, and a small napkin or cloth on the left. The right hand keeps hold of a water brush and moves it from the palette area toward the paper, then makes short, light strokes on the green lily pad as if rinsing or wiping pigment off to clean the brush tip, while the left hand shifts slightly and rests near the napkin and paper to steady the workspace.
